news.title: AdaGS-Net Paper Accepted by ICME 2026
news.content: Our paper "AdaGS-Net: An Adaptive Sparse Network for Multimodal Fusion in Alzheimer's Disease" has been accepted by ICME 2026. Congrats to all authors!
news.excerpt: Our paper on adaptive sparse network for multimodal fusion in Alzheimer's Disease has been accepted by ICME 2026.

news.title: Multi-modal Brain Tumor Segmentation Paper Accepted
news.content: Our paper "Multi-modal Brain Tumor Segmentation via Multi-category Interaction and Graph Co-reasoning" has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia. Congrats, Li, Yang and co-authors!
news.excerpt: Our paper on brain tumor segmentation has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia.

news.title: Federated Learning Framework Accepted by PRCV
news.content: Our paper "FedCD: A Hybrid Federated Learning Framework for Adaptive Training under Data Heterogeneity" has been accepted by PRCV. Congrats, Zhan, Yang and co-authors!
news.excerpt: FedCD framework for adaptive training under data heterogeneity accepted by PRCV conference.

news.title: CAM-interacted Vision GNN Paper Accepted
news.content: Our paper "CAM-interacted Vision GNN for Multi-label Medical Images" to be published in IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics. Congrats, Wang, Yang and co-authors!
news.excerpt: A multi-label medical image paper will be published in IEEE JBHI.

news.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Paper Accepted
news.content: Our paper "Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Algorithm Using Dynamic OW-QMIX in Complex Supply Chain Scenarios" has been accepted by IEEE SMC. Congrats, Liu, Zhu and co-authors!
news.excerpt: A supply chain optimization paper has been accepted by IEEE SMC.

news.title: Two Papers Accepted by ECAI
news.content: Two of our papers were accepted by ECAI: "FairFed++: Closing the Fairness Gap in Federated Learning through Self-Evolving Clustered Optimization" and "Unlocking the Potential of mLLMs: Enhancing Video-Text Retrieval through Caption Supplementation and Conical Embedding Optimization".
news.excerpt: Two papers were accepted by ECAI.

news.title: Sub-Volume Contrastive Learning Paper Accepted
news.content: Our paper "Simple but Effective: Sub-Volume Contrastive Learning for Class-Imbalanced Semi-Supervised 3D Medical Image Segmentation" has been accepted by ACM Multimedia. Congrats, Xu, Yang and co-authors!
news.excerpt: A 3D medical image segmentation paper has been accepted by ACM Multimedia.

news.title: Federated Learning with Noisy Paper Accepted
news.content: Our paper "Harnessing Feature Distribution Consistency for Federated Learning with Noisy" has been accepted by IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP). Congrats, Ma, Yang and co-authors!
news.excerpt: A federated learning paper has been accepted by ICIP.

news.title: Welcome New Group Members
news.content: Warm welcome to new group members Aoqi Yan, Guangyang Lin, Haifeng Lin, Jiahao Lian, Xiaojie Chen, Xi Wang & Yuhao Chen
news.excerpt: Warm welcome to 7 new group members joining our research team this semester.

news.title: Official Website Launched
news.content: Beyond Machine Learning team introduction official website officially launched!

news.title: Two Papers Accepted by ICME
news.content: Two of our papers were accepted by ICME: "Unifying Spatio-Temporal Contexts for Advanced Text-Video Retrieval" and "Action Decomposition-based Actor-Critic for Supply Chain Optimization".
news.excerpt: Two papers were accepted by ICME.

news.title: Vessel Segmentation Paper Accepted by ICASSP

statistics.text: The dataset contains 110K video samples, each of which is ac-companied by audio, as well as systematic and detailed textual descriptions.
statistics.title: Dataset statistics

introduction.text: VideoMind is a large-scale video-centric multimodal dataset that can be used to learn powerful and transferable text-video representations for video understanding tasks such as video question answering and video retrieval. The corresponding description of each video corresponds to three layers, namely factual layer, abstract layer, intentional layer.
items: The factual layer includes visual description, OCR of video frames, ASR of videos, description of audio, and the title of the original video
The intentional layer consists of two parts: the intent of the video uploader and the intent of the video main character
introduction.title: What is VideoMind?

content.name: Dr. Baoyao Yang(Associate Professor)
paragraphs: Dr. Baoyao Yang, a distinguished young faculty member recruited under the "Youth Hundred Talents Program" at Guangdong University of Technology, obtained her Bachelor’s degree from South China University of Technology in 2014 and her Ph.D. from Hong Kong Baptist University in 2018. She has spearheaded several key research projects, including the National Natural Science Foundation General Program, Youth Science Fund, and multiple provincial/ministerial-level scientific research initiatives. Her contributions were recognized with the 2023 Guangdong Province Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Prize, ranked fourth individually).

Dr. Yang has authored over 50 publications in top-tier journals such as IEEE TIP, TIFS, and TNNLS, as well as leading conferences like AAAI and MICCAI. She holds six authorized national invention patents and emphasizes the integration of industry, academia, and research. Committed to mentorship, she has guided students to win awards in national competitions and helped numerous undergraduates gain admission to prestigious institutions for advanced studies.
